llm.summary: This is a prompt-writing helper for Jimeng image and video generation, with a disclosed but privacy-relevant feature that saves visual preferences for later sessions.

dimensions.detail: The skill's capabilities fit its stated purpose: it routes Jimeng model choices, asks for creative requirements, drafts image/video prompts, and may use optional reference media guidance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions stay within prompt generation and workflow guidance; trigger phrases are broad for image/video requests, but they are consistent with a prompt-helper skill.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown instructions and a reference memory file only; no executable scripts, dependencies, credentials, or install-time commands beyond normal skill installation were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill may ask users to provide photos, videos, or audio as generation references, which is expected for visual prompting but can involve personal media.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly maintains references/evolution-memory.md to save visual preferences and feedback across sessions; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should treat it as retained preference data.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the skill saving visual style preferences and generation feedback in its memory file for reuse in later sessions. Avoid sharing sensitive personal details or private media unless you are comfortable using them in the Jimeng workflow, and review or clear the memory file if you do not want prior preferences to influence future prompts.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] expected: The cited memory read/reuse behavior is real, but it is repeatedly disclosed as the skill's 'evolution memory' feature and is limited to visual prompt preferences.
[SDI-1] expected: The body does write session preference summaries, but the frontmatter also advertises cross-session preference tracking, so this is not hidden scope expansion.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger phrases are broad, but they target ordinary image/video prompt requests and do not add unrelated authority or execution behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: The persistence lacks explicit opt-in, retention, and deletion controls, which is a user-awareness issue; artifact evidence does not show deception or unrelated data capture.
[SSD-3] expected: The skill can retain feedback and preferences over time, but the stored categories are visual style, tone, camera, and generation feedback rather than credentials or broad local/private content.
